```{r}

```

```{r}
library(lubridate)

our_stops = stops[, c("stop_date", "stop_time", "county_name", "driver_gender", "driver_age", "driver_race", "violation", "search_conducted", "search_type", "contraband_found")]

our_stops
colSums(is.na(our_stops))

# fill missing search type values
# no_search if search_conducted is false
# no_type if search_conducted is true
our_stops <- our_stops %>%
  mutate(search_type = case_when(
    is.na(search_type) & !search_conducted ~ "no_search",
    is.na(search_type) & search_conducted ~ "no_type",
    TRUE ~ search_type
  ))

colSums(is.na(our_stops))

# convert stop time to binned time groups
# drop rows with NA
our_stops <- our_stops %>%
  mutate(
    stop_time_bin = na_if(stop_time, "NA"),
    stop_hour = hour(hms(stop_time_bin)),
    stop_time_bin = case_when(
      is.na(stop_hour) ~ NA_character_,
      stop_hour >= 0  & stop_hour < 4  ~ "late_night",      # 0:00-3:59
      stop_hour >= 4  & stop_hour < 7  ~ "early_morning",  # 4:00-6:59
      stop_hour >= 7  & stop_hour < 12 ~ "morning",        # 7:00-11:59
      stop_hour >= 12 & stop_hour < 17 ~ "afternoon",      # 12:00-16:59
      stop_hour >= 17 & stop_hour < 21 ~ "evening",        # 17:00-20:59
      stop_hour >= 21 & stop_hour < 24 ~ "night",          # 21:00-23:59
    ),
    stop_time_bin = factor(stop_time_bin,
      levels = c("late_night", "early_morning", "morning", "afternoon",
                 "evening", "night"))
  )
our_stops <- our_stops %>% 
  filter(!is.na(stop_time_bin)) %>%
  select(-stop_time)
our_stops
```
